claim: Blackpink debuted Aug 8, 2016 with single album Square One ('Boombayah' + 'Whistle')
First girl group to debut under YG Entertainment in seven years
'Whistle' hit #1 on the Gaon (now Circle) Digital Chart; 'Boombayah' #1 on Billboard World Digital Songs; fastest act to hold top two on that chart
Fandom name 'BLINK' revealed
Jennie joined YG as trainee in 2010 after returning from New Zealand (~6 years to debut)
Jisoo joined YG as trainee in July 2011 (~5 years to debut)
Rosé ranked first among 700 applicants in YG's 2012 Australia audition, moved to Seoul (~4 years to debut)
Lisa was the only one of 4,000 applicants to pass YG's 2010 Thailand audition; moved to Korea 2011 as YG's first non-ethnic-Korean trainee (~5 years to debut)
Group name 'Blackpink' confirmed Jun 29, 2016 with four members (plans dated to Nov 2011); rejected names incl. Pink Punk, Baby Monster, Magnum
2NE1 disbanded Nov 25, 2016 (Minzy left Apr 2016; CL & Dara stayed, Bom released; final single 'Goodbye' Jan 2017) — backdrop to Blackpink's debut
CL and Minzy revealed (2021) they were not informed of 2NE1's disbandment beforehand; public backlash against YG
UNVERIFIED: ~33 group songs 2016-2025 total (counting rule dependent; core discography ~29-33)
EP 'Square Up' released Jun 15, 2018; 'DDU-DU DDU-DU' #1 Gaon Digital, Hot 100 debut #55 (then-record for a Korean girl group)
'DDU-DU DDU-DU' MV: 36.2M views in 24h; first K-pop group MV to 1B views (Nov 2019) and 2B views (Jan 2023)
EP 'Kill This Love' released Apr 5, 2019; MV 56.7M views in 24h, then the most-viewed video in first 24 hours
'How You Like That': 86.3M views in 24h; broke 5 Guinness World Records incl. most-viewed video in first 24h and 1.66M peak concurrent premiere viewers
'How You Like That' won Song of Summer at 2020 VMAs — first Korean female act to win a VMA
'The Album' (Oct 2, 2020): first album by a K-pop girl group to sell 1M copies (~1.2M in under a month); first girl group to top Billboard Artist 100

'Born Pink' (Sep 16, 2022): first K-pop girl group album to sell 2M+; first album by a female Korean act to top Billboard 200; first K-pop girl group #1 on UK Albums Chart; first girl group to top US+UK since Destiny's Child (2001)
Guinness most-subscribed band on YouTube at 60.3M (2021); 93.8M and most-subscribed music act overall (2024)
First artist in the world to surpass 100 million YouTube subscribers (Feb 20, 2026); received custom 'Red Diamond Creator Award'
Most-viewed band on YouTube: 30.15B views (2023 record) extended to 41.75B (2026)
Guinness most-streamed female group on Spotify: 8.88B streams (2023) extended to 16.94B (2026); 40B+ total streams and 20M+ records sold worldwide
Born Pink World Tour (Oct 15, 2022 - Sep 17, 2023): 1.8M total attendance, most-attended tour by a Korean girl group; #10 on Billboard 2023 Year-End Top 40 Tours
Born Pink World Tour grossed $330M — highest-grossing tour ever by a female group (broke Spice Girls' 2019 record) and by an Asian act
First Asian act ever to headline Coachella (Apr 2023); in 2019 first female K-pop group to perform at the festival
Deadline World Tour announced Feb 2025, kicked off Jul 5, 2025 at Goyang Stadium; first K-pop girl group to play London's Wembley Stadium; tour title revealed May 16, 2025
'Jump' released Jul 11, 2025 via new Orchard distribution deal (replacing Interscope): 3rd Billboard Global 200 #1, 4th Global Excl. US #1 (most by any female act), Hot 100 #28
UNVERIFIED: Deadline World Tour (2025-26) final gross/attendance — no authoritative full-tour figure surfaced; partial Billboard Boxscore reports only
EP 'Deadline' (Feb 27, 2026): 1,461,785 first-day Hanteo copies (record for K-pop girl group), 1,774,577 first week; Billboard 200 #8; first group album release in ~3.5 years
Jennie's 'SOLO' topped Gaon/Circle Digital and Billboard World Digital Songs; MV first by a Korean female soloist to surpass 1 billion views
Jennie acting debut in HBO 'The Idol' (2023) as Jennie Ruby Jane; show cancelled after one season; her role as Dyanne praised
Jennie founded her own label Odd Atelier (Nov 2023)
Jennie's 'You & Me' — first solo #1 on Billboard Global Excl. US
Jennie's album 'Ruby' (Mar 7, 2025): 1M copies first week globally; UK Albums Chart #3 (highest for K-pop female soloist at the time); 3 simultaneous Hot 100 entries — first K-pop female soloist

Lisa's 'LALISA' (Sep 10, 2021): first female artist to sell 736,000 copies in first week in Korea; MV most-viewed in 24h by a solo artist (Guinness); first K-pop solo artist to win a VMA (Best K-Pop 2022)
Lisa's 'MONEY' became first K-pop soloist track to 1B Spotify streams (her 8th Guinness World Record, Sep 2023); headlined Crazy Horse Paris Sep 2023
Lisa launched her own management company LLOUD (announced Feb 8, 2024)
Lisa's 'Rockstar' via LLOUD/RCA (Jun 27, 2024); TikTok Guinness 1M followers in 2h18m; 'New Woman' w/ Rosalía (Aug 15, 2024)
Lisa's debut album 'Alter Ego' (Feb 28, 2025): Billboard 200 #7, Top Album Sales #1
Lisa made her acting debut in HBO 'The White Lotus' Season 3 (2025)
Lisa most-followed K-pop idol on Instagram since Apr 2019; first K-pop idol to 50M (Apr 2021); Guinness most-followed K-pop artist at 87M (Jan 2023); ~106M as of Sep/Oct 2026
Rosé's single album 'R' (Mar 12, 2021): 448,089 first-week copies (record for Korean female soloist); 'On the Ground' topped Billboard Global 200 — first artist to #1 as both soloist and group member
Rosé signed with The Black Label (Jun 2024) and Atlantic Records (Sep 2024) for solo work outside YG/Interscope
Rosé & Bruno Mars' 'APT.' released Oct 18, 2024 via The Black Label + Atlantic; Billboard Hot 100 debut #8, peaked #3 (verified peak)

'APT.' UK Singles Chart: debuted #4, peaked #2 — claim of 'first K-pop female #1 on UK official chart' is FALSE; it did top charts in Canada (first K-pop female artist), Australia (first solo K-pop ARIA #1 since 'Gangnam Style'), New Zealand; perfect all-kill in Korea
'APT.' MV passed 1B YouTube views in 105 days (Jan 31, 2025); fastest K-pop artist MV to 500M; fastest female K-pop solo MV to 200M

'APT.' = IFPI best-selling global single of 2025 (first artist outside North America/Europe to top IFPI Global Single Chart); first K-pop act to win VMA Song of the Year (2025); 3 Grammy nominations (68th) — most for any Korean artist

Jisoo's solo album 'ME' (Mar 31, 2023): best-selling album by a Korean female soloist and first by one to sell 1M+; 'Flower' #2 Billboard Global 200 and Circle Digital; then-records for Korean female soloist on Canadian Hot 100 and UK Singles Chart
Jisoo founded her own agency Blissoo (2023)
Jisoo lead role in JTBC 'Snowdrop' (Dec 2021): #1 on Disney+ in 4 of 5 launch countries
Jisoo: EP 'Amortage' (2025), film debut, Netflix 'Boyfriend on Demand' (2026), single 'Click' (Sep 4, 2026) teasing first full studio album

Dec 29, 2023: YG announced members did NOT renew individual contracts; solo activities independent — Jennie (Odd Atelier), Jisoo (Blissoo), Lisa (LLOUD) founded own agencies; Rosé signed with The Black Label — the structural break
